title: Tangy Egyptian Pastry Tart
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make pastry tart perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of tangy feta cheese and Egyptian spices will transport you to the Mediterranean.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a small bowl, mix together the feta cheese, Egyptian spice blend, and chopped parsley.
Spread the feta mixture evenly over the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the olive oil over the feta mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry crust is golden brown and the feta mixture is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
